Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard…
Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again…
who drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the best oils; but they are not grieved for the affliction of…

people.name: Gallio
people.line: Roman proconsul of Achaia; refused to judge Paul.

people.name: Sosthenes
people.line: Synagogue ruler in Corinth, co-sender of 1 Corinthians.

translations.web: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.
translations.bsb: At this, the crowd seized Sosthenes the synagogue leader and beat him in front of the judgment seat. But none of this was of concern to Gallio.
translations.kjv: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.
translations.asv: And they all laid hold on Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment-seat. And Gallio cared for none of these things.
